description: DC fault benchmark, 800 V: a 400 V 50 Hz grid behind its impedance feeds a diode bridge (a blocked VSC) onto DC bus A with a 10 mF DC-link capacitor; a 200 m cable (pi section) to DC bus B, where a battery sits behind its internal R and L and the fault is. Every capacitor starts at 800 V, every inductor at 0 A. SI units.
